subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should this issue stay as the canonical four-agent Telegram/provider concurrency investigation, be split into narrower Telegram/provider/runtime issues, or close only after a comparable main-branch live run proves the original timeout pattern is gone?
rationale: The remaining problem crosses Telegram ingress, model fallback, provider transport, session locking, and launch/default policy, and the current evidence only proves partial mitigations.

options.title: Require Current-Main Live Repro
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a current-main four-agent Telegram trace before choosing a code or config change.

options.title: Split By Owning Layer
options.body: Move the remaining work into narrower Telegram ingress, provider transport, and runtime timeout issues if maintainers decide this report is too broad to own directly.

options.title: Close After Mitigation Proof
options.body: Close only if a comparable current-main live run shows the all-provider timeout pattern no longer occurs.

recommendation.title: Require Current-Main Live Repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a current-main four-agent Telegram trace before choosing a code or config change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across gateway timeout propagation and model-fallback abort handling adjacent to this report.
